excerpts.content:
It is very much unclear if it will be necessary to subsidise zk proving in-protocol at all:

a) by contrast to consensus which assumes N/2-of-N ('51%') honest participants, zk proving comes with a generous 1-of-N assumption

b) the cost of zk proving are largely TBD - and more likely than not will significantly decrease going forward
(make sure to follow the latest autoresearch developments, e.g. <http://snark.fast> among others)

Also noteworthy: it has been community consensus to introduce FOCIL (i.e. an added validator duty) without touching validator rewards
